name: UpdateWorkItem
label: Update Work Item
description: Updates the fields or status of an existing work item.

fields.name: WorkItemId
fields.label: WorkItem ID
fields.description: Enter the unique identifier of the work item you want to update.

fields.name: Status
fields.label: Status
fields.description: Select the new status to assign to the work item.

selectOptions.label: Pending
selectOptions.description: Work item is pending and not yet started.

selectOptions.label: In Progress
selectOptions.description: Work item is currently being processed.

selectOptions.label: Completed
selectOptions.description: Work item has been completed successfully.

fields.name: Remark
fields.label: Remark
fields.description: Optional remark for the work item.

fields.name: ShouldUpdateWorkItemData
fields.label: Should Update Work Item Data
fields.description: Indicates whether the work item data should be updated. If true, the Work Item Data field must be provided.

fields.name: WorkItemData
fields.label: Work Item Data
fields.description: Provide the updated data for the work item in JSON format. This field is required if 'Should Update Work Item Data' is set to true.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the result of the update operation.
